high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from Google search results, displaying a map titled "Map of cases (last 14 days)." The map is sourced from JHU CSSE COVID-19 Data and other sources, as indicated by the text below the title. The map shows various countries in South and Southeast Asia, with blue dots representing the number of COVID-19 cases over the last 14 days. The countries highlighted include Iran, Afghanistan, Pakistan, India, Nepal, Myanmar (Burma), Thailand, Malaysia, and parts of China. The map is interactive, with zoom controls on the right side for adjusting
